QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 2 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew, the Democratic donkey, needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: Stew's troublesome nephew spilled their supply of printing ink. He needs you to help him find more near the catering tables.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Blue Ink. Return to Stew.

0.0: Okay, there's a tiny problem. I may have accidentally let my nephew into the supply closet and he may have spilled all the ink we need to print our fliers.
0.1: Uh, do, uh, do you think you could maybe get me some from near the catering tables? I really don't want to tell my boss.

yes.0: You are a lifesaver. A real American hero.

no.0: Ah geez, I guess I kept this job as long as I could.

1.0: Finally! I was like 10 minutes away from getting fired.

yes.0: Maybe I can get this kid some proper education now. You wanna do an interview sometime? I know a few reporters...

stop.0: Is blue that hard to find?
